tei:div.tei:p: rje btsun blo bzang grags pa'i ngang tshul cung zad brjod pa bzhugs so//

na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ blo chen rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /bzang po'i smon lam rlabs chen grub pa'i mthus/ /grags pa'i sgra chen thub bstan 'gro ba'i dpal| |blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /dpag yas tshogs gnyis kun gyi rtse mor son/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba kun gyi rigs lugs 'dzin| |mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba'i bshes/ /bsam yas yon tan kun gyi gter la 'dud/ /gangs can shar phyogs tsong kha'i skyed tshal du/ /dal 'byor yongs 'du'i rtsa ba rab brtan zhing*/ /yon tan yal gas phyogs kyi mtha' 'jal ba/ /snyan grags dri bsung 'phro ba khyod la 'dud/ /dri med mkhyen yangs 'jigs bral gzhon blo sogs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i mkhas pa kun bsten nas/ /spyi dang khyad par gzhung lugs mtha' dag la/ /rmongs pa'i mun kun sangs pa khyod la 'dud/ /snyogs bral tshul khrims brtul zhugs rgya mtsho cher| |mang thos lung rigs nor bus lhag par gtams/ /mkhas mchog klu dbang kun gyis gus pas bsten/ /rnam dpyod gting mtha' med la gsol ba 'debs/ khyod blo'i nyi mas gzhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ /bdag blo khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ byang phyogs 'di na tshig tsam byang ba'ang dkon/ /don la sgro 'dogs chod pa de bas dkon/ /bstan don nyams su len pa srid mtha' tsam/ /'di gsum mthar phyin khyod la snying nas 'dud| |la la rigs bral lung gis grub mtha' 'jog kha cig lung med rigs pa ltar snang tsam/ /lung rigs gnyis kas rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun/ / legs par 'byed pa khyod la gus phyag 'tshal/ kha cig 'dul ba gtsor byas gsang sngags spong*/ /gzhan dag sngags la mos blos 'dul ba 'go /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag 'gal med du/ /rdzogs par nyams su len mkhas khyod la 'dud| |mtshan nyid phyogs bzung gsang sngags zab chos dang*/

/sngags kyis khengs nas mtshan nyid kha bshad tsam/ /mdo sngags mtha' dag ma tshang rdzogs byang du/ /'grod thabs med par gzigs pa khyod la 'dud/ /la la spyod pa zhib mos lta ba 'gogakha cig lta ba mthon pos spyod pa 'dor// lta spyod phan tshun grogs su shar nas ni/ /don 'di lhag par 'doms pa khyod la 'dud/ /'ga' zhig bshad pa gtsor byed sgom la smod/ /la la sgom gyi chog 'dzin lung la smod// bshad sgrub gnyis kas lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin tshul gsal mdzad khyed la gus pas 'dud/ /mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje'i theg/ rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med don/ /rim gnyis mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen khyed la 'dud/ /mdor na thub bstan mtha' dag ma lus par/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyis ches cher gsal mdzad pas/ /gangs can 'di na bstan 'dzin mtha' dag gis/ /rtag tu bsngags par 'os pa khyod la 'dud/ /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du| |bdag nyid chen po khyod bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bdag pas gzhan gces lhag bsam phul byung gis/ /bdag gi srog ltar srung bar byin gyis brlobs| khyod la gtsor byas ha cang mchog 'dzin gyis/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis thub bstan 'khrugs pa yang*/ /dag snang phyogs med 'byongs pa khyod nyid kyis| |myur du bsal nas bstan 'dzin mthun gyur cig /ces gangs ri'i khrod 'dir phyis kyi bstan 'dzin chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi ngang tshul mdo tsam du brjod pa/ dad pa'i pad mo rgyas par byed pa'i bstod tshig gi nyi ma zhes bya ba/ gtsang stag tshang gi lo tswa ba dge slong shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba'o/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs mtha' dag tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/rje btsun blo bzang grags pa'i ngang tshul cung zad brjod pa/
